# Semgrep for the kirocrew-dev Coder image, every file hash-pinned (pip
# --require-hashes). The semgrep version is the one CI runs (code-review.yml,
# "Install Semgrep (pinned)"); test/test_coder_dev_template.py fails when the
# two differ. Covers linux amd64 and arm64. Regenerate after a bump with:
#   echo semgrep==<version> > /tmp/semgrep.in
#   uv pip compile /tmp/semgrep.in --universal --python-version 3.12
#     --generate-hashes --no-header --no-annotate -o semgrep-requirements.txt
# (one command, wrapped here)
# then put this header back.
